correctness.rationale: The biset orbit sizes give |M|=37. The displayed Cartan matrix has determinant 16. The characteristic-three decomposition matrix yields [[14,10],[7,5]], whose determinant is exactly zero. The zero-element block contributes [1] and changes neither result.
